next.reason: The 1985 rule only makes the relative SAME clause the sequential one. 2023 has one SAME clause for every file in I-O-CONTROL, and §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR4 'The files specified in a given SAME clause need not all have the same organization or access', so a relative file uses the same clause; its content is carried by the sequential SAME rule's record.
